## Purpose

Synthetic project used as a fixture for the `gantt-chart` skill's Linear integration (Phase 1). The shape exercises:

* A standalone anchor issue (estimate present)
* A FS chain (one issue blocks another)
* A fan-in (one issue blocked by two others)
* A parent / sub-issue hierarchy
* An issue with no estimate (tests the missing-estimate fallback path)
* A project milestone

**Safe to delete from the Linear UI anytime — no real work tracked here.**

See `~/Documents/gantt-chart/docs/specs/linear-integration.md` for the design.
